finding.summary: This looks like it would break horribly if Homebrew isn't present (e.g. in Linux).

label: real_issue
label_reason: A human reviewer raised this in pyenv/pyenv#1646 (merged 2021-09-17), and a later commit in the PR changes the file.
notes: Hand-picked with Claude Code (PMAT-310): https://github.com/pyenv/pyenv/pull/1646. Bash: calls `brew` with no check that Homebrew is present, so it breaks on Linux. Human reviewers are not perfect ground truth, and they give no severity, so any severity counts.
